title: MassTransit
description: A distributed application framework for .NET that simplifies message-based communication.

data.text: MassTransit is a distributed application framework for .NET that simplifies message-based communication. It provides a consistent programming model for working with message brokers like RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, and ActiveMQ.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install MassTransit and the RabbitMQ transport.
data.code:
dotnet add package MassTransit
dotnet add package MassTransit.RabbitMQ

data.title: Sending and Receiving Messages
data.content: Configure MassTransit and send a message.

terms.definition: The main entry point for sending and publishing messages.
An interface for consuming messages of a specific type.

data.title: Best Practice
data.text: Use MassTransit with a message broker like RabbitMQ for reliable, decoupled communication.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: MassTransit is ideal for building robust, distributed .NET systems.
